list.title: Contracts
list.subtitle: Work you agreed on Vyapar, paid milestone by milestone.
list.emptyBody: When an enquiry is accepted, the person paying can start a contract from the conversation.
list.selectHint: Choose a contract to see its milestones and payments.

sandbox.title: Test payments
sandbox.body: Payments run in sandbox mode today: no real money moves. Held and paid amounts are recorded by Vyapar exactly as they will be when the payment partner goes live.
sandbox.recorded: Held and paid amounts are recorded by Vyapar. Money reaches the provider once Vyapar's payment partner is live.

new.title: Start a contract
new.subtitle: Agree the work and how it is paid. {{name}} accepts it before anything is charged.
new.titlePlaceholder: For example: kitchen rewiring for the new oven
new.descPlaceholder: Where, when and anything agreed in the conversation
new.milestonesHint: Each milestone is paid when you approve that part of the work.
new.msTitlePlaceholder: For example: wiring and socket for the oven
new.fillLast: Put the rest in the last one
new.balanced: Milestones add up to the total
new.fromProposal: Filled in from {{name}}'s proposal. Change anything you like.
new.notClientBody: The person paying for the work starts the contract. It will appear in your Contracts for you to accept once it is sent.
new.notAccepted: A contract can be started once the enquiry is accepted.
new.how2: You fund a milestone. Vyapar holds it.
new.how4: You approve and it is paid. If you say nothing for 14 days, it is approved for you.
new.errMilestone: Every milestone needs a name and an amount.
new.errSum: Milestones must add up to the total.
new.errRate: Enter the hourly rate and the weekly hours.
new.notForJobs: Contracts are for projects and local services. A salaried job is paid by the employer directly.
